name: x-thread-saver
description: Password-protected X post and conversation archiver for Cloudflare Workers

scripts.deploy: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy

APP_PASSWORD.description: Choose a strong private password for the archive web interface.

SESSION_ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: Generate 32 random bytes and encode them as Base64 (for example: openssl rand -base64 32). Keep this value safe; changing it makes saved X login cookies unreadable.
